title: Train Reservation System
instructions: Implement `TrainReservationSystem` in `config/trainReservation.py`. It stores a dict of available seats per seat type (`1AC`, `2AC`, `3AC`, `Sleeper`) and a `threading.RLock` named `lock`. `reserve_seats` and `get_available_seats` hold the lock, and each reservation is one atomic check-and-decrement that never lets a count go negative.

evidence.label: The lock attribute is a threading.RLock
Reserves, refuses and handles the exact boundary
Seat types do not affect each other
Concurrent bookings across seat types give exact counts
Counts never go negative when demand exceeds supply
Check and decrement form one critical section
